{{Short description|Japanese molecular biologist}}
{{Nihongo|'''Yoshiyuki Sakaki'''|榊 佳之|Sakaki Yoshiyuki}} is a Japanese [[molecular biology|molecular biologist]]. He was the sixth president of [[Toyohashi University of Technology]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.tut.ac.jp/english/introduction/universitys_history_2.html|title=University's History|access-date=2016-07-27|archive-date=2016-08-07|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160807072632/http://www.tut.ac.jp/english/introduction/universitys_history_2.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> and an [[emeritus professor]] of the [[University of Tokyo]].

Sakaki was born in Nagoya. He received a [[bachelor's degree]] in [[biochemistry]] from the University of Tokyo, and received a [[Ph.D.]] in biochemistry from the University of Tokyo in 1971.
